headline: KIIRAS drop 'OVER U' teaser ahead of Nov 26 return
sub: A cheerleading concept for their first release in six months
caption:
KIIRAS have dropped the teaser for 'OVER U', their 2nd digital single out Nov 26.

The six-member multinational girl group returns about six months after their last release with a cheerleading concept. The upbeat title track is about the confidence of pushing past your limits, and the single also includes '3-5-4-6'. It drops at 6 PM KST on major music sites.

📌 Source: 1theK, via Korean media (Sports World, Newsen)
